newsitem.title: UK: SAfrica's Ramos unveils 4 bln rand borrowing plans.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's Ramos unveils 4 bln rand borrowing plans.

text.p: South African finance department director general Maria Ramos said on Monday that South Africa plans to borrow four billion rand in foreign currency for the remainder of the financial year.
"We have four billion rand to do in foreign currency out of our total borrowing requirements," she told Reuters at an investment conference.

"We are looking to do a yen issue, which we expect to do in two weeks' time," she said. That issue would probably total about two billion rand, while the balance would be raised in the Yankee bond market.
The yen issue would have a maturity of up to 10 years while the Yankee issue would be over 10 years, she said.
However, she noted that the timing in the Yankee market is critical.
"We are now in the process of working out whether we do something immediately after the yen issue or we wait."
She said the borrowings are part of the country's routine deifict financing.
